comments: Also available as a CI/API service (regression budget, verdict endpoint, public badge). By design it does not inject anything into the pages it audits (no overlay). ACT rules implementation report planned.
features: a11y.es runs scheduled WCAG 2.2 audits of your website with a real browser, generates hash-verifiable evidence packs and an honest badge with the measured score, and connects human reviewers who sign the results. No in-page scripts; automated CI checks included. Spanish and English.
title: a11y.es
